_readme: University job mix for one DH-Pro rack (30 x 1 kW). Every task uses one full 1 kW server.
Volumes are ASSUMPTIONS sized for ~60 % utilisation (the corrected pitch base case).

hardware.gpu: 1 kW GPU server (one task = one server)
hardware.source: Case brief: reference rack server 1 kW

arrival_profile.source: Alibaba cluster-trace-gpu-v2020, pai_task_table: share of 732,691 completed GPU tasks started in each hour of the day (68 days, July-Aug 2020). The trace keeps time of day but shifts timestamps by a constant, so the hours are in the trace's own time zone (likely UTC+8). The profile is fairly flat: 2.8 % to 6.9 % per hour.

job_types.source: Interactive: must run when students work (weekdays 09:00-18:00, semester Feb-May and Sep-Dec, ASSUMPTION based on the Uni Basel semester calendar). Not interruptible. Volume: ASSUMPTION.
